name: Road car: MacPherson front (Yang 2019, CEVT), five-link rear (Grzyb & Kowalski 2001)
source: The corner geometries are the library models macpherson_front and five_link_rear. The vehicle data are assumed values of a compact car: sprung mass 1500 kg (the corner_mass of the two models), 53 percent on the front axle, CG height 550 mm, wheelbase 2700 mm, roll, pitch, and yaw inertia 500, 2000, 2200 kg m^2, cornering stiffness 1200 N/deg front and 1300 N/deg rear per tire (a 205/55 R16 tire near 4 kN, about 0.3 per degree of the load).
